agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
May 6, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for March 17, 2026, Special Planning Commission
  Meeting; and April 1, 2026; Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Travis Albini,
  representing Chick-fil-A, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00024(SUP25-00024) to allow a proposed 5,031 square-foot fast
  food restaurant with a drive-through and outdoor dining within
  a shopping center on a C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property
  at 3003 West Manchester Boulevard.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-002) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email request to
  faith.smith@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-002;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00024.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A Public Hearing to consider an application by Rebecca Silva,
  representing Savvy Beauty Academy for Special Use Permit No. 26-
  00002 (SUP26-00002) to amend certain conditions of approval to
  Special Use Permit No. SP-2018-018 for a cosmetology school on
  an H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at 240 South Market Street.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-043) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email at al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-043;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00002.
 Preliminary Recommendations (cont’d):
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

c. A Public hearing to consider an application by Liliger Damaso,
  representing Liquor License Brokers for Special Use Permit No.
  26-00003 (SUP26-00003) to allow the on-site sale of beer, wine,
  and distilled spirits within 1) an existing juice bar & coffee
  bar, 2) an event center, and 3) live entertainment within an
  existing gymnasium that is part of the Hollywood Park Tomorrow
  retail center on an HPSP (Hollywood Park Specific Plan) zoned
  property at 1265 south District Drive.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-044) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email at al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

Preliminary Recommendations:
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-044;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00003.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

d. A Public hearing to consider an application by William
  Lancaster, representing Advance America for Special Use Permit
  No. 26-00007 (SUP26-00007) to allow check cashing and other
  alternative financial services within a shopping center on an
  H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at 425 East Manchester
  Boulevard.

  A Notice of Exemption has been prepared (EA-CA-2026-042) stating
  the proposed project is categorically exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is available for
  public review in the Planning Division office of City Hall and
  via email request to bespinoza@cityofinglewood.org

Preliminary Recommendations:
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CA-2026-042;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00007
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents
 7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Inglewood
  Open Studios, to allow the installation of three (3) murals in
  different locations on H-C (Historic Core) zoned properties.

  Notice of Exemptions (EA-CE-2026-050), (EA-CE-2026-051), and
  (EA-CE-2026-052) have been prepared stating that the proposed
  projects  are  categorically  exempt  from  the  California
  Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is available for
  public review in the Planning Division office of City Hall and
  via email request to smay@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-050, EA-CE-2026-051,
  and EA-CE-2026-052;
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR26-00016,
  DR26-00017, and DR26-00018.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of May 6, 2026, is not
held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 3, 2026, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
